content.text: {"answer": "data", "evidence": "Every alert has an escalation code. The code selects the ladder: the owning team is paged first, the tier duty engineer after the acknowledgement window has passed, and the incident commander after a further thirty minutes with no acknowledgement. An alert that is acknowledged but not resolved does not climb the ladder; it stays with the owning team."}
